name: Machine-user worker uses synthetic bot credentials and commit identity while isolated owner credentials remain usable
GitHub App worker mints repository-scoped tokens, reuses cache, and refreshes expired tokens through localhost API
Authentication guards reject read-only access, public token files, embedded remote credentials, and owner netrc
Local notification poll saves owner mentions and assignments as instructions and marks stranger or collaborator-edited text do-not-act
Local polling deduplicates replay, preserves cursor after HTTP failure, handles commits/reviews/deleted latest URLs, and disarms a running poll
